0022600157.text: The Lakers (4-2, 1st in the Pacific, 5th in the West) host the Toronto Raptors (3-2, 3rd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) in Los Angeles' seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams coming off one-game losing streaks. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation), and Ziaire Williams is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision, while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Lakers won their 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 110-93 win in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
